result: FAIL (regression found by this run, then fixed)
cause: The overlay change in 4dc3307 hid boxes whenever video.seeking was true. Unpaced replay advances the paused preview by seeking on every poll, so the video was almost always mid-seek and the boxes almost never drew.
fix: Boxes follow the last presented frame (requestVideoFrameCallback mediaTime) while playing or seeking; they are hidden mid-seek only when no presented-frame time is available.
